research.job_description_summary: SAP Labs India hires freshers as Associate Developers / Software Developers. A FACE Prep guide (undated) describes an online test (about 25 aptitude MCQs, 2 to 3 coding problems, technical MCQs on OOP, DBMS and OS), two technical interviews, a managerial interview and an HR interview. A June 2026 Glassdoor review lists sorting, normalization, C, data structures, paging, segmentation, puzzles and OS topics; the managerial and HR rounds were described as a formality. The official SAP careers pages were not fetched.
limitations: SAP's official careers pages were not fetched, so no round is marked DOCUMENTED.
The FACE Prep guide has no date and presents its questions as typical patterns, not candidate reports; it is used as topic context (class D).

Candidate-attributed material: one June 2026 Glassdoor review (Associate Developer; topics only) and one undated LeetCode account of a Developer Associate (Java full stack) that mentions 'current work' and so appears to be an experienced hire. Its coding problems, Java-service questions and six managerial questions are class B, one report each, unverified, and may be harder than new-graduate interviews.
A February 2026 review for Potsdam, Germany was excluded as out of region.
Managerial questions beyond the LeetCode account are original practice.

Evidence handling: practice questions cite no sources; where a source only supplied topic context it is named in the question notes. Practice and job-description-inferred questions are UNVERIFIED and capped at LOW confidence on import.

Review status: answers, samples and cited counts come from the researcher and were not independently re-run; spot checks only. Source titles and some dates are blank because the sources did not show them.
Source pages on LeetCode Discuss and Glassdoor returned HTTP 403 to the CodeArena audit tool (2026-10-11), so the cited questions were not re-confirmed against those pages.

questions.relevance_to_role: A FACE Prep guide describes a first technical round on DSA, OOP, DBMS, OS and SQL; a June 2026 Glassdoor review lists sorting, normalization, C, data structures, paging and segmentation.
